title: Loom · camera / ground / pair law
note: No family sheets. Import in Scale Lock without roster. Velora owns cloth. Kitty owns 16-inch look. This owns camera height, ground, ruler, pair-fail, still-before-motion.
law: Scale first, look second. Camera height is law. One ground. One ruler. One body per name. Kitty is inches; adults are feet. If a chair is in the shot, say who sits and who stands.

scaleInvert.kitty: 16-inch figure ON the chair seat. Chair back taller than her head.
scaleInvert.wardrobe: adult human IN the chair, feet on the floor.
scaleInvert.rule: Never load Kitty chair/palm/shin bible on a wardrobe Build that sits IN the chair.

camera.walk: CAMERA: locked tripod at adult chest. Not hero-low. Not aerial.
camera.street: CAMERA: at street, not aerial god-shot, not dollhouse. Lamps at head height.
camera.lookbook: CAMERA: at chest. Cloth first. Locked tripod.
camera.partner: CAMERA: at adult chest. Door or second figure in frame so the shell cannot inflate.
camera.node: CAMERA: locked tripod wide. Building is the subject. Humans small.
camera.kitty-personal: CAMERA: full adult wooden chair in frame. Seat is the ruler. Optional seat-height. Not hero-low.
camera.kitty-palm: CAMERA: adult eye-line. Palm and forearm in frame. Not worm's-eye.
camera.kitty-amazon: CAMERA: adult eye-line. Both full body. Floor visible.
camera.kitty-sheet: CAMERA: even distance. Adult and 16-inch figure, same floor, full bodies.
camera.kitty-look: CAMERA: even studio. No hero angle. Solo plate.
camera.sheet: CAMERA: even studio light, locked, no hero angle.

ground.adult: GROUND: all adult feet share one floor. Contact shadows. Hem clears the wet. No floating soles. No sinking into asphalt.
ground.kitty-personal: GROUND: Kitty's paws on the wooden seat. Chair on the floor. She does not share the street with adult feet unless an adult stands beside the chair.
ground.kitty-palm: GROUND: one contact — standing in an adult open palm. Adult feet on the floor. No second floor for her.
ground.kitty-amazon: GROUND: she stands at the shin. Adult feet on the floor. Both full body.
ground.kitty-sheet: GROUND: both full body, feet on the same floor, 16-inch difference obvious.
ground.sheet: GROUND: plain dark studio ground. One person.

rulers.line: RULER: door handle at adult hip. One ruler only.
RULER: adult wooden chair; seat at adult mid-thigh; Kitty stands ON that seat. One ruler only.
RULER: curb to adult ankle. One ruler only.
RULER: cup or strap in a real adult palm, not swallowed. One ruler only.
RULER: whole Kitty shorter than the adult forearm; head no larger than a knuckle. One ruler only.
RULER: porch lamp at adult head height. One ruler only.

technique.wet-street: TECHNIQUE: locked tripod, rain as depth, practical neon rim.
technique.wood-door: TECHNIQUE: warm practical, door as ruler.
technique.bay: TECHNIQUE: single hard key from the bay door.
technique.eave: TECHNIQUE: eave just above head, rain is weather.
technique.walk: TECHNIQUE: fabric practicals, camera at chest.
technique.lookbook: TECHNIQUE: fabric practicals, camera at chest.
technique.street: TECHNIQUE: locked tripod, rain as depth.
technique.partner: TECHNIQUE: locked tripod, door in frame as scale.
technique.node: TECHNIQUE: locked tripod wide, one violet band at storey-line.
technique.sheet: TECHNIQUE: even studio light, plain dark ground.

i2v.gate: Motion copy off until still has shared floor, one camera height, one ruler, identity lock.

negativeScale: no toddler, no giantism, no size drift, no extra people, no second chair, no floating feet, no readable brands, no extra limbs, no warped furniture scale, no figurine on the cushion, no dollhouse, no giantess

ok.when: kitty mode personal + adult standing, wardrobe pose not sit

hard.when: kitty personal + adult + wardrobe sit, or pose sit
hard.message: Adult IN the chair and Kitty ON that seat are two bibles. Do not mix.
fixes: Kitty only — solo still, uncheck the adult
Kitty on seat, adult standing beside — switch pose off Sit, hand on the backrest

hard.when: injectCity and cityFightsKitty and kitty and sit
hard.message: Walk / street / lookbook / partner sit is IN-chair. Kitty personal is ON-seat.
fixes: Keep City, switch wardrobe pose to Stand or Three-quarter, adult beside the chair

hard.when: two height modes of the same character
hard.message: One body lock per name. 5'2" personal and 6'6" amazon are not a lineup.
Character sheet is one person. Same face, same cloth, four views.

warn.message: Node plates dwarf humans. Don't also load walk-scale invert.
Still first. Motion after the scale reads.

checkOrder: size-drift words: giantess, dollhouse, same-height couple, figurine on the cushion
